description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” visually compares the execution times of five different models — “Our Joint Framework,” “ChatGPT,” “DeepSeek,” “LLaMA,” and “Claude” — on the SEconvo dataset within a streaming context. The horizontal axis lists these models in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis quantifies runtime in seconds using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400, marked at 50-second intervals with dashed gridlines for reference. Each model’s runtime is represented by a single vertical bar: “Our Joint Framework” is shown with a dark green bar at 77 seconds, significantly lower than all other models, which are depicted with light blue bars. The runtimes for the LLM models are explicitly labeled atop their respective bars: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds (not 300 as stated in the caption), LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. The legend in the upper left corner distinguishes “Our Joint Framework” (green) from “LLM Models” (light blue). Contrary to the caption’s claim, DeepSeek’s runtime (365s) is higher than Claude’s (243s), not lower, and ChatGPT’s runtime (190s) is approximately 10.5% higher than LLaMA’s (172s), not nearly 20%. The chart emphasizes the efficiency of “Our Joint Framework” through its substantially shorter bar and distinct color, while the numerical labels ensure precise interpretation of each model’s performance.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment' compares the runtime performance of various models on the SEconvo dataset. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, labeled as 'Our Joint Framework,' 'ChatGPT,' 'DeepSeek,' 'LLaMA,' and 'Claude,' ordered from left to right. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, featuring a linear scale from 0 to 400, with tick intervals of 50 seconds. The green bar representing 'Our Joint Framework' has a runtime of approximately 77 seconds, while the light blue bars representing the other models have runtimes as follows: 'ChatGPT' at 190 seconds, 'DeepSeek' at 300 seconds, 'LLaMA' at 172 seconds, and 'Claude' at 243 seconds. Notably, 'DeepSeek' demonstrates a runtime reduction compared to 'Claude,' contrary to expectations based on model complexity. Additionally, 'ChatGPT' exhibits a runtime increase of nearly 20% compared to 'LLaMA,' suggesting potential inefficiencies in streaming environments. The numerical labels at the top of each bar provide clarity for runtime values.
